title: 3D loose guns: Inspector, Kammerer, Mosin and speedloader
scope: Art only: source-faithful 3D held/dropped Inspector, Kammerer, Mosin and SpeedLoaderMagnum, with source-visible state coverage; no gameplay code or unrelated guns.
target_runtime: Minecraft Java 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1.224: existing ItemRenderer baked-item and loose block_model/NONE route, neoforge:obj + MTL #atlas + atlas PNG + complete item wrappers; not wearable interchange or sprite-only models.
dependencies: Use the frozen MODEL-BRIEF.md and MODEL-SAMPLES.md contracts and pinned SS14 entity/RSI references.
Independent of the magazine-fed and energy requests; do not duplicate their assets or overwrite weapon_revolver_python.
Manual cycling is inherited provider behavior; named editable mechanical parts do not imply an existing animated OBJ renderer.
brief: Create true volumetric 3D models for WeaponRevolverInspector, WeaponShotgunKammerer, WeaponSniperMosin and SpeedLoaderMagnum. Preserve the six-chamber revolver, recognizable shotgun pump and Mosin bolt hardware, source proportions/palettes and actual fill/state appearances. Do not invent mechanical animations from prototype descriptions or additional attachments. Include the separate speedloader and actual source-visible loaded/empty differences. No flat sprites, sprite-on-box proxies, generic block guns or code-generated placeholders. Deliver complete supported native OBJ/MTL/#atlas PNG/item-wrapper groups, both-hand held transforms and documented NONE-context world placement. Include editable projects, grip/muzzle/support-hand and reload-access documentation, source comparison, six views, atlas, actual held/dropped review images, and per-file provenance/license. Read the attached brief for canonical paths and review requirements. Delivery is not acceptance/import.
